gameDescriptionHtml:
Buy cooking equipment, prepare delicious meals, and serve hungry customers. Upgrade your setup, read customer reviews, and expand your business to become the top fast-food joint in the city.

Game Features

  • New Worker Types: Runner – Carries food boxes, restocks supplies, and refills cooking stations; Chef Upgrade – Now refills stations when food boxes are available in his station; Cleaner – Keeps the restaurant spotless, no more garbage piles; Cashier – Takes orders, collects food, and serves customers.
  • Restaurant Expansion: Grow your restaurant, expand the cooking area, and even open a second floor for more customers! Add extra cash registers to handle the rush and keep customers happy.
  • Decorate & Personalize: Paint walls and floors to match your style. Add flowers, paintings, and custom signboards to make your restaurant stand out. Rename your restaurant and truly make it your own!
  • Take customer orders and serve their meals quickly to keep them happy and earn positive reviews.
  • Design and furnish your restaurant with tables, chairs, and decorations to attract more diners. Keep it spotless to ensure excellent reviews and customer satisfaction.
  • Hire skilled cooks and staff to improve efficiency and train them to run operations smoothly.
  • Upgrade your equipment, experiment with new recipes, and expand your restaurant’s size and reach to dominate the fast-food industry in the city.
